goal: Pin the exact Graphify builder wall-clock execution timeout as a forward-only supply-chain contract amendment without implementing or executing Graphify.

verified_facts.statement: I10-P0-R1 started from protected hwm-control/main 8d0c62c5b5c147a3cfd6d0ef202850292cda2bd4, hwm-lab/main e37ea628d9c793d5e87bc8b903a9b85b4371991c, hwm-context/main d651f40d0bb3a3ef0e52fca95e5400ed3db3d772, and hwm_predictor/main 8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4.

The protected I10-P0 supply-chain contract, ADR 0007, graph-health schema, focused P0 tests, I10-0072 Knowledge Delta, and Issue #72 surfaces define timeout fail-closed semantics but do not pin an exact numeric Graphify builder execution timeout.
The historical v1 predecessor is immutable at exact Git blob a22feb23061d96e920f4a8974bdbb94de9e8988e and the protected core BUILD_STATUS schema map remains closed and unchanged.

Owner-approved remediation decision is one authoritative monotonic full-builder wall-clock timeout of exactly 900 seconds with fail-closed timeout_incomplete_build behavior, partial-output discard, deterministic raw-source fallback, and clean disposable retry only.

Controlled publisher request i10-0083-claim-v1 published the claim BUILD_STATUS to exact task-branch commit 026ed7fb3b352e4941857b8da4b87f82ad0296c7; its exact-head Infrastructure CI 32903269083 passed bootstrap invariants but failed only because the repository Knowledge Delta gate required knowledge-deltas/I10-0083.json for the active task.

verified_facts.statement: Issue #73 was left open and unclaimed and was changed from ready to blocked with an explicit dependency on I10-0083; Issues #74 and #75 remain ready/unclaimed and Issue #76 remains blocked.

No Graphify execution, production graph creation, hwm-lab mutation, hwm-context mutation, hwm_predictor mutation, provider/API/model/billing capability, or publisher/workflow widening has occurred in this remediation.

decisions.decision: Create hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v2 as a forward-only amendment and keep v1 byte-for-byte immutable.
decisions.rationale: The exact timeout was omitted from the accepted P0 contract, so retroactively changing v1 would erase historical provenance.

decisions.decision: Use exactly 900 seconds on a monotonic wall clock for the complete builder execution boundary and require a new versioned amendment for any future change.
decisions.rationale: The implementation agent must not choose or silently relax a correctness- and availability-affecting timeout.

decisions.decision: Materialize an intermediate task Knowledge Delta before source-contract publication.
decisions.rationale: The protected repository Knowledge Delta gate requires a canonical delta as soon as I10-0083 appears in active_task_ids; recording unresolved terminal evidence preserves fail-closed lifecycle truth without weakening CI.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The accepted v1 blob is historical contract evidence and must remain immutable.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Let Issue #73 choose a timeout or increase it after a timeout failure.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would move a normative architecture decision into implementation and permit silent policy drift.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Bypass the failing claim CI or use a generic source writer.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Exact-head CI and the installed controlled publisher are mandatory trust boundaries.
